notes: Mappings reproduce the documented conventions; boundary sensitivity remains required.
Null metadata columns require source annotation review; sample/replicate IDs are not assumed to be embryos.
Relative source and asset paths resolve from the repository root.

2026-09-23 probe-asset audit (read-only): unresolved cell_type/embryo_id/assay fields were reviewed against each dataset README and the source papers (citations in per-dataset metadata_provenance). Fields are resolved only to real obs columns; documented constants are recorded in metadata_provenance with citations but stay null in metadata_columns because audit_probe_dataset requires a real source column (remaining 'assay lacks a verified source column' blockers are expected).

Embryo pooling is documented for pig_simpson_2024 (23 pooled samples / 62 embryos), xenopus_briggs_2018 (5-15 embryos per library), ciona_cao_2019 (100-500 embryos per sample) and amphioxus_markos_2024 (15-20 embryos per sample): embryo_id stays null with precise reasons in metadata_provenance.

fasta_manifest_pep.json now covers all six probe species (verified URLs: HTTP 200, Content-Length and headers inspected 2026-09-23). Key-namespace findings per species are in fasta_provenance below and in logs/dataset_audit/probe_b4_esm2_plan.md.

macaca_fascicularis.var_namespace_check: MISMATCH: the three macaque probe files index genes by symbols/LOC tags (macaque_zhai_2022 var 'gene': 16,895 symbol-like + 9,230 LOC*; macaque_gong_2023 var 'gene_id': 18,168 + 15,790; macaque_spatial var 'gene_symbol': 4,663 symbols). Parsed FASTA keys are ENSMFAG stable IDs: 0/26,135, 0/33,960 and 0/4,663 exact var matches. pep gene_symbol values overlap 12,613 / 14,202 / 3,263 var names, so joining would require a symbol->ENSMFAG map (symbol ambiguity unresolved).

cavia_porcellus.var_namespace_check: MATCH at the gene-ID level: var index is composite 'ENSCPOGxxxxx:SYMBOL'; the ENSCPOG component matches the Cavpor3.0 pep gene: namespace for 15,333/19,323 var genes (the remainder are non-coding genes without protein products). Exact string keys differ by the ':symbol' suffix, so a lookup must strip the suffix. Canizo et al. 2025 aligned to Cavpor.3.0.v105, the same assembly as this FASTA.

ciona_intestinalis.header_gene_tag: ABSENT: headers are '>NP_001007565.1 hyaluronan-mediated motility receptor [Ciona intestinalis]'; no gene: tag, no KH2012 IDs (feature table uses LOC100xxxxxx symbols / GeneID).
ciona_intestinalis.var_namespace_check: MISMATCH: var index is 'KH2012:KH.C1.xxx' (15,228/15,269; plus 39 ENSCING000000xxxxxx and 2 constructs mChSV40/CFPSV40). protein_embedding.py would key this FASTA by NP_/XP_ protein accessions. No verified FASTA exposes KH2012 gene IDs: Ensembl Metazoa (checked release-39..63) has no Ciona; the Ghost database cited by Cao et al. 2019 now publishes KY/KY21 models (e.g. 'KY.Chr1.580.v1.ND1-1'), not KH2012. GCF_000224145.3 is the exact species and the KH assembly used by Cao et al., but a KH2012<->RefSeq mapping table would be required (not built here).

branchiostoma_floridae.header_gene_tag: ABSENT: headers are '>XP_035657338.1 uncharacterized protein LOC118403009 [Branchiostoma floridae]'; no gene: tag.
branchiostoma_floridae.var_namespace_check: PARTIAL MISMATCH: var index is NCBI locus tags 'LOC1184xxxxx' (29,309/29,726; rest tRNA/etc.) from the Bfl_VNyyK annotation (Markos et al. 2024 quantified against GCA_000003815.2 = GenBank counterpart of GCF_000003815.2). 6,273/29,726 var genes appear verbatim as 'LOC1184xxxxx' tokens in pep descriptions (6,274 unique), but protein_embedding.py parses only 'gene:' and would key by XP_/NP_ accessions instead of LOC gene IDs. The older GCF_000003815.1 (JGI 'Version 2') pep carries JGI protein-model IDs ('BRAFLDRAFT_111961', 0 LOC overlap) and is the wrong key namespace.

fasta_provenance.sus_scrofa_existing_entry: pep keys ENSSSCG (Sscrofa11.1) match pig_simpson_2024 var 'gene_id' (ENSSSCG; Simpson et al. 2024 used Sscrofa11.1 / Ensembl v109) - compatible.
fasta_provenance.xenopus_tropicalis_existing_entry: pep keys ENSXETG do NOT match xenopus_briggs_2018 var 'gene_name', which uses gene symbols / JGI v1 names ('arhgef26', 'Xetrov90007505m', 'LOC100485680'). Pre-generated xenopus embeddings (see logs/dataset_audit/probe_b4_esm2_plan.md) inherit the same ENSXETG keys and will not join to var_names without a symbol->ENSXETG map.

datasets.species_provenance: Source README and Zhai 2022 identify Macaca fascicularis; source obs has no species column.

metadata_provenance.cell_type: resolved: obs['cell_type'] (38 author clusters) - Zhai et al. 2022, Nature, DOI 10.1038/s41586-022-05526-y (GEO GSE193007).
metadata_provenance.embryo_id: resolved: obs['sample'] (6 values CS8-e1/CS8-e2/CS9-e1/CS9-e2/CS11-e1/CS11-e2). Zhai et al. 2022 abstract: 'we collected six Carnegie stage 8-11 cynomolgus monkey embryos and performed in-depth transcriptomic analyses of 56,636 single cells' (56,636 = n_obs); Sup. Tables 1-2 describe 7 embryonic samples, matching the 7 obs['orig.ident'] libraries. Cross-tab: sample CS11-e1 pools orig.ident {E26-E1, E26-Y1} - the 7th library is a second tissue sample of the same CS11 embryo (Fig. 1a distinguishes embryo tissue 'e' and yolk sac 'ys'). Residual caveat: the E/Y tissue reading of orig.ident is inferred from that figure legend; if E26-Y1 were an independent embryo, embryo_id would have to be orig.ident (7 values) instead of sample (6 values).
metadata_provenance.assay: unresolved by column (obs has no assay column). Documented constant = 10x Genomics Chromium: Zhai et al. 2022 Methods ('Samples were dissociated into single cells, with 67,418 sequenced using the 10X Genomics Chromium platform') and Sup. Table 1.

datasets.path: /mnt/d/sc/data/scRNAseq-YBY/h5ad/食蟹猴_Macaca_fascicularis/Cell_ex_utero_embryogenesis/食蟹猴_Macaca_fascicularis__Ex utero monkey embryogenesis from blastocyst to early organogenesis.h5ad

metadata_provenance.cell_type: unresolved: the source provides no cell-type annotation. Dataset README (Cell_ex_utero_embryogenesis/README.md): the GEO matrices carry no author UMAP/PCA/coordinates or final cell-type annotations and none were recomputed or added.
metadata_provenance.embryo_id: resolved: obs['sample'] (24 values 'GSM…_replicate_N_MEdd', 1:1 with obs['gsm']). GEO GSE207534 titles each GSM 'ME…, replicate N, scRNAseq' with characteristic 'cell type: Embryo' (singular), i.e. each 10x library is one embryo replicate destructively sampled from an individually cultured ex utero embryo (Ma et al., Cell 2023, DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2023.04.020). Residual caveat: neither GEO GSE207534 nor the dataset README states embryo counts per library; if any replicate pooled embryos this column is per-library rather than per-embryo identity. obs['replicate'] (4 values) alone is NOT an embryo identity - it restarts at each ME stage.
metadata_provenance.assay: unresolved by column. Documented constant = 10x Genomics Chromium Single Cell 3' v3.1: GEO GSE207534 '!Sample_description = 10x Genomics' and extract_protocol 'Chromium Single Cell 3' Reagent Kit v3.1 protocol, 10x Genomics'; dataset README ('10x 矩阵'). Note: the GEO extract_protocol field also contains unrelated mouse goblet-cell text (deposit artefact); the 10x lines cited here are corroborated by the dataset README.

datasets.path: /mnt/d/sc/data/scRNAseq-YBY/h5ad/食蟹猴_Macaca_fascicularis/空间转录组_CS9_CS10_Nature_Cell_Biology/食蟹猴_CS9_CS10__A three-dimensional spatial transcriptome atlas reconstructs early organogenesis in primate Carnegie stages 9 and 10 embryos.h5ad

metadata_provenance.embryo_id: unresolved: no per-cell embryo identity in obs. The finest sampling identity is obs['spatial_slice_id'] (20 serial sections, 10 per stage) - sections are not embryos (docs/finetune-readiness-tools.md §2) and must not be used as embryo IDs. Neither the dataset README (空间转录组_CS9_CS10_Nature_Cell_Biology/README.md), the Zenodo record README (10.5281/zenodo.19061842) nor the Nature Cell Biology 2026 abstract (DOI 10.1038/s41556-026-01956-2) states how many embryos the 20 slices came from, so stage->embryo identity is not derivable. obs['orig.ident'] (157 values) is a capture/technical identifier, not an embryo.
metadata_provenance.assay: unresolved: no assay column and no citable platform constant. Available sources say only 'high-resolution spatial transcriptomics' (Nature Cell Biology 2026 abstract) and 'Spateo-aligned 3D coordinates, 20 slices' (dataset README and Zenodo README). Spateo suggests but does not document the imaging/sequencing platform, so no constant is asserted.

metadata_provenance.embryo_id: unresolved: pooled embryos without per-cell labels. Simpson et al. 2024 (Nat Commun, DOI 10.1038/s41467-024-49407-6) Results: 'we obtained scRNA-seq profiles from 23 pooled samples encompassing 62 pig embryos'; Methods: cells from pools of same-stage embryos were loaded per 10x chip lane. obs['Sample'] (23) is the pooled-sample ID, obs['Sow'] (7) the dam, obs['Chip']/obs['SeqPool'] 10x/sequencing batches - none is a per-cell embryo identity.
metadata_provenance.assay: unresolved by column. Documented constant = 10x Genomics Chromium: Simpson et al. 2024 Methods ('Approximately 4000-14000 cells per lane of each 10x chip were transferred. The chip was then loaded into a Chromium Controller') and GEO GSE236766; dataset README.
